name: Rain of Fangs
body:
School conjuration (creation); Level druid/shaman 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, DF

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Area cylinder (30-ft. radius, 20 ft. high)
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

A rain of razor-sharp animal fangs and teeth rains down upon the area, dealing 3d6 hp piercing damage to every creature in the area. This damage occurs only once, when the spell is cast. In addition, each creature taking damage from the fangs also receives bleed damage equal to half your caster level.
